ContentRef.description:
Where a large or sensitive body lives: `event_content.hash` (xxh3-128
hex) and its length. Retention may delete the body; the ref stays.

size.description: The whole body's length, stored or not.

truncated.description: Only the first part was stored (bodies are capped).

description:
`agent.context.compacted@1`: the agent's context was summarized to make
room, so what it was told earlier is no longer in front of it.

summary.description:
The summary the context was replaced with (Claude's
`compact_summary`), stored in `event_content`; read as
`event:<id>#summary`.

trigger.description:
What started it, as the harness names it (Claude's `auto` or
`manual`), when it says.

turn.description: The session's turn open when it compacted, when one was.

title: AgentContextCompactedV1
